prompt:
Character reference sheet, one wide image in two parts, photorealistic photograph. LEFT two-thirds: full-body turnaround of the same person, three views side by side at identical scale: front view, exact 90-degree side view, exact 180-degree back view, relaxed A-pose. RIGHT third: close-up head-and-shoulders portrait of the SAME person facing camera, mouth closed. Plain light-grey background, soft even studio light at a neutral white balance, no shadows, healthy natural skin with real texture, not airbrushed, no text, no labels, no watermark.
The person: Natalie, a fictional 25-year-old, the heroine; George's daughter from his first marriage, who agrees to marry Sebastian Klein to pay for her mother's dialysis; the face, skin and build of exactly that age, which the role does not change. Appearance: A breathtakingly beautiful Caucasian American woman of 25 who looks young and fresh. She has a small, delicate oval face with high, softly sculpted cheekbones, a refined straight nose, a gently tapered jaw and large, bright, intelligent blue-green eyes under softly defined light-brown brows. Her very fair, luminous, even skin has healthy natural texture and no redness. Long golden-blonde hair falls well past her shoulders in soft, glossy, glamorous curls with a side part. Her make-up is soft, natural and glamorous: defined brows, long fluttery lashes and a glossy natural-rose lip. She is tall, about 175 cm, with long legs and elegant supermodel proportions, about eight heads tall. Curvy figure, full hips, defined waist, hourglass shape: a glamorous hourglass silhouette with a Hollywood-glamour editorial poise. Her gaze is self-possessed. No marks. She wears no jewellery in daily life.. Wearing one outfit only: A powder-blue ribbed-knit mini dress in stretch knit that hugs her figure and is cut to cinch at the waist, with short sleeves, a low scoop neckline and a hem at mid-thigh. No belt. Nude pointed-toe heels and a small structured nude handbag. No jewellery, no coat.. Signature colour: blue. In the close-up a calm, attractive expression with bright, intelligent eyes and only a hint of: Gentle and quietly captivating on the surface. Kind-hearted and vulnerable, and bullied by her stepfamily, but resilient and strong-willed underneath. She will swallow her pride for her sick mother, but she demands they keep their word and she defends a groom she has never met.; no tears. The full-body views keep the body's build and proportions as the appearance gives them, head-to-body ratio included, never slimmer. Cast as a commercial live-action short drama: a lead (the heroine, the hero) or a young adult woman in a prominent role is a strikingly beautiful or handsome, camera-ready actor, with the figure, make-up and hair the appearance gives; any other supporting role is an ordinary-looking person of that age.
The outfit is identical in every view and in the close-up: the same garments, accessories and details on the same side of the body, seen from that view's angle (an earring on the left ear stays on the left ear; a tie, a pocket square, gloves or hair ribbons are in every view or in none). Garments are plain, with no logo, brand mark, or printed letters or numbers.

Avoid: a different face between the views, an older-looking or younger-looking face than 25, doll-like face, a second outfit, extra people, extra limbs, text or labels.
